*Mahāsukhavajra*: [Oṃ] Mahāsukhavajra-samaya hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ. *Ākarṣaṇa-pāpa* (Summoning of Sins):

[Oṃ] Vajrasattva samayam anupālaya vajrasattvatvenopatiṣṭha dṛḍho me bhava sutoṣyo me bhava supoṣyo me bhava anurakto me bhava sarvasiddhiṃ me prayaccha sarvakarmasu ca me cittaṃ śreyaḥ kuru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bhagavan sarvatathāgatavajra mā me muñca vajrībhava mahāsamayasattva āḥ. *Uddharaṇa-pāpa* (Extraction of Sins): [Oṃ] Sarvapāpāni viśodhaya svāhā.
[Oṃ vajra sattva] Purify the three karmas: [Oṃ vajra sattva āḥ hūṃ]. Bodhicitta: [Oṃ bodhicittam utpādayāmi]. Universal prostration: [Namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ].
The Heart of Penetrating Understanding: *Om vajra-tīkṣṇa-prajñā-jñāna-vajra-āloka-hūṃ phaṭ* The Heart of Realizing Bodhicitta:
*Om vajra-bhura-bhura hūṃ phaṭ* The Heart of Manifest Clarity: *Om vajra-āloka-hūṃ phaṭ*
Eight-petaled lotus: Oṃ vaṃ maṃ. Visualization of one’s own body as the deity: Oṃ āḥ hūṃ.
Empowerment by all Tathāgatas: Oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhāna-samaya-śrīye hūṃ.

Brief recitation, walking the path, and even the most casual practice.
Regarding the ritual for recitation at that time:
first, protect the body, from the self-vessel-world up to the donning of the armor; next, form the seal of the Small Vajra Wheel and recite the mantra.
Next, bind the root mudrā and recite the root mantra to consecrate the four places.
Then, place the vajra-palms upon the crown of the head and recite the syllable *Bhrūṃ* twenty-one times; this is the method of offering.
Next, bind the fundamental mudrā and recite the fundamental mantra twenty-one times; from this point onward, it is not necessary to count with a rosary, as one may proceed as appropriate.
The manuscript states:
"On the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month in the second year of Eicho, this was respectfully copied.
It was requested by the monk Kenzon and transcribed from the original hand-copied manuscript of the Sōjō (Chief Abbot) of Hannyaji."
